title: Applicable reliability quantities of the hall_icp_neutralizer flight configuration (evidence-parameterised reliability block model)

authority_rule: This JSON is authoritative. PREREG.md restates it for people; a difference is a defect fixed by a new version.
numbers_policy: This record contains no failure rate, life, shape parameter, duty factor, horizon or threshold value. Every number below is a software-verification tolerance or a closed-form constant of an analytic limiting case (e, 1, 0). Parameters enter only as evidence records (EI-01).

Per the plan (GR-02) the applicable reliability quantities are therefore a preregistered NEW_PHYSICS element. No synthetic Python reference is created (A9.28; template RM-R26).

not a reliability result, not a failure-rate source and not a reliability allocation

architecture_scope.text: Configuration hall_icp_neutralizer only, supply modes AIR_PRIMARY and XE_CONTINGENCY. Any other configuration (hall_c1_reference included) is refused: MODEL_ERROR.
C1 / hollow cathode: GROUND_REFERENCE_ONLY. No C1 item, heating or start-cycle item enters a flight reliability block diagram; an RBD that names one is refused (MODEL_ERROR, FT-03).

Item vocabulary (registered RBD item classes; an item instance is registered per RBD): INTAKE, FILTER, COMPRESSOR_ROTOR, COMPRESSOR_BEARING_MOTOR, PLENUM_FEED_VALVE, XE_FEED, HALL_ANODE, HALL_CHANNEL_WALL, HALL_MAGNET_CIRCUIT, ICP_SOURCE, ICP_COLLECTOR, RF_GENERATOR, RF_MATCHING, PPU_CONVERTER, HARNESS_CONNECTOR, THERMAL_CONTROL. A new class is a new version.

quantities.definition: probability that a registered item has not failed by its operating time t (h) under its registered failure-mode model
system reliability of a registered reliability block diagram at mission time t, items evaluated at their operating times (E-05)
lower / upper R over the registered parameter box (E-06), reported with the nominal
EVALUATED | NOT_EVALUATED | INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE | OUT_OF_DOMAIN | MODEL_ERROR per item and per RBD (precedence ST-01)
the items ordered by ascending R at t (an ordering only; no SPF or marginal label, no threshold)

equations.name: independent competing modes of one item
RBD composition
equations.form: SERIES: R = prod_i R_i; ACTIVE_PARALLEL: R = 1 - prod_i (1 - R_i); K_OF_N (identical R): R = sum_{j=k..n} C(n, j) R^j (1 - R)^(n - j); nested blocks registered as a tree

equations.name: operating time
equations.form: t_i = registered operating-time record of item i at mission time t (from the SC-WP-09 mission profile: firing hours, cycles); no default duty factor; a missing record is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE

equations.name: parameter-box bounds
equations.form: R is monotone in each parameter for fixed t: decreasing in lambda, increasing in eta; in beta decreasing if t / eta > 1, increasing if t / eta < 1, constant at t = eta. R_bounds are evaluated at the registered box corners of (lambda) or (eta, beta), which is exact under this monotonicity; RBD bounds follow because E-04 is monotone increasing in each R_i

evidence_inputs.rule: Every lambda, eta, beta and operating-time record is an input record {value, bounds, units, source (path + sha256 or citation + locator), evidence_class, evidence_level, uncertainty, applicability_domain (stress, temperature, environment, duration range), validation_status}. A record missing a field is MODEL_ERROR.

No default and no invented value (CLAUDE.md rules 3 and 6). An item without a sourced parameter record is INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; it is never filled from a handbook value that is not transcribed with source and locator.

Wear-out eta derived from a life model is admissible only from an ADMITTED model under its own contract: Hall channel-wall erosion life needs an admitted Hall map with wall_life_trustworthy (CLAUDE.md next-work 5); with the credible Hall set EMPTY every Hall-erosion-derived eta is NOT_EVALUATED. Anode / collector material is OPEN (P4: 352 gate cells INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE; 316L REJECTED_AS_CURRENT_BASELINE): material-dependent anode / collector items are INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.
AO-driven items (intake, filter, compressor exterior surfaces) need AO coupon / AO-beam evidence (owner row 132, UNLOCK['life']); without it INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.

Candidate evidence source types (none transcribed here; each 'verify'): P4 stage-3 qualification / life evidence, H-1 endurance tests, ICP endurance tests, compressor bearing / motor life tests, parts-stress failure-rate handbooks (e.g. MIL-HDBK-217F, FIDES) applied with their own applicability domains.

domains.rule: lambda finite >= 0; eta finite > 0; beta finite > 0; t finite >= 0; otherwise OUT_OF_DOMAIN.
t outside the applicability_domain duration range of an item's evidence record is OUT_OF_DOMAIN unless the record itself states the extrapolation domain; no extrapolation factor is invented.
An item's stress / temperature / environment outside its record's domain is OUT_OF_DOMAIN.

precedence.rule: MODEL_ERROR (malformed record / RBD, refused configuration or C1 item) > NOT_EVALUATED (a required admitted upstream model is absent, e.g. EI-03) > INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (parameter evidence absent) > OUT_OF_DOMAIN > EVALUATED; an RBD takes the highest-precedence item status; no partial R_rbd is emitted unless every item is EVALUATED

outputs.rule: Raw quantities only (Q-01..Q-06) with status, inputs' source ids, uncertainty bounds and validation_status NOT_VALIDATED. No threshold, margin, PASS / FAIL, SPF / marginal label or requirement constant. Horizons are caller inputs; the legacy key R_26000h (LEGACY_RELIABILITY_HORIZON_H) is never emitted.
outputs.on_refusal: No R value is emitted for an item or RBD whose status is not EVALUATED.

assumptions.text: Failure modes within an item are independent (E-03); common-cause coupling is not modelled in v1 and is listed as a limitation of every R_rbd.
Redundancy is only what the registered RBD states; no redundancy is assumed (the class-H redundant electronics pair is not carried).
Constant hazard only where the evidence record states random-failure behaviour; wear-out modes use E-02.

conservation.criterion: 0 <= R <= 1 and |R + F - 1| <= 1e-15 for every item and RBD
SERIES R_rbd <= min_i R_i; ACTIVE_PARALLEL R_rbd >= max_i R_i (exact inequalities on the computed values)

analytic_limiting_cases.case: series of n identical exponential items
active parallel of two identical items

analytic_limiting_cases.closed_form: k = n equals SERIES; k = 1 equals ACTIVE_PARALLEL
dR/dlambda <= 0, dR/deta >= 0, beta rule by sign of ln(t / eta) on a registered grid

fail_closed_tests.case: HALL_CHANNEL_WALL item whose eta comes from Hall-map wall erosion with the real (EMPTY) credible set
any item without a sourced parameter record
an RBD naming a C1 / hollow-cathode item or configuration hall_c1_reference

fail_closed_tests.case: HALL_ANODE / ICP_COLLECTOR material-dependent item while the anode / collector material is OPEN

determinism.rule: Byte-identical outputs for identical inputs (no RNG; sums in registered item order).

independent_verification.source: closed forms AL-01..AL-06 evaluated independently (non-authoritative scratch cross-check, never an active or CI dependency)

validation_plan.rule: Verification (AL, CONS, FT, DET) is software admission only. validation_status stays NOT_VALIDATED until measured life / reliability evidence for the registered items exists; dependent gates stay NOT_EVALUATED.
